content.comment_body: Hello, I was able to use the web server of [product_name] successfully on my PC. However, when I try to access the web server from another PC on the same internet connection, it doesn't work at all. Any suggestions would be appreciated. Best regards ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [product_name] server web not available.

Which web server are you referring to? Do you mean the basic web server, which only shows the display of a [product_name] or an operator device? Or are you asking about the advanced web server that provides user-defined web pages?

analysis.insight_summary: A user notes that the web server for [product_name] functions properly on one PC but fails on another, despite both devices using the same internet connection. This points to possible configuration or compatibility problems. Another user requests clarification about which type of web server (basic or advanced) is being referenced, highlighting some confusion over product features.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the web server of [product_name] to operate reliably across multiple PCs sharing the same network, without requiring additional configuration.
